text: The ordinary or common origin worn by the knights, is a flat of four River points, and over them a green circled, borders and offered through pink, containing the find motto, and in the camera is a thilfe proper, all which is embroidered on their left breastf, and womb with the collay, with a great method over the shoulder, and brought under the right arm i pender thereto is the iimage of St Andrew, with his crois, in a purple robe, within an oral of gold canamelled very, with the former motto - but femonettes they were, existed in the June manner, a hittle crowned.
